title.zh: 可关闭自定义内容提示框

description.zh: Paradise UI 的 AlertWithCustomContent 原始 story：信息提示框含标题和正文，右侧关闭按钮淡出后收起。
description.en: The original AlertWithCustomContent story: an info alert with a heading, body copy and a close control that fades out before removal.
